fullVerify.scope: local working tree; synthetic local users; no deployment or external AI execution
fullVerify.notes: Canonical board integration verification: npm run verify exit 0 with approved local test-server permissions; generated mission/project/database files synchronized. All five added board/draft tests were included. No external AI, cloud, trading or deployment. Final evidence/log updates followed by generated-source and whitespace checks.

limitations: Simple entry uses a fixed software preparation template, not arbitrary instruction decomposition by an LLM; detailed catalog routing remains keyword suggestions and registered next-task expansion.

Catalog-generated goals require coverage and acceptance review; all-squad closure includes missing detailed plans. Simple request templates auto-draft acceptance statements for explicit owner confirmation, then require concrete scope/path/test/effort review in their first three tasks.
Goal state is a separate local ledger and does not automatically update canonical AMC status.
Actors and evidence references are self-reported. No authenticated identity, cryptographic audit, evidence-content or file-existence verification.
No direct ChatGPT/Codex Goal entry, API execution, durable cloud process, or Scaleway startup.
Execution holds conservatively block even their document-preparation children. Parent dependencies are inherited without silently relaxing gates.
Physical, external, build and unclassified new leaf tasks require a future authority/resource adapter. Local concurrency settings are not hardware capacity measurements.
UI flow tested with a mock DOM; real browser rendering and external execution are not claimed.

simpleBriefRevision.request: Replace the difficult chat questionnaire with one request, then only Goal and intent confirmation; retain functionality.
flow: roles, tasks, provisional effort and decisions
simpleBriefRevision.preparation: Bounded software-local-prototype template: four proposed roles and seven sequential tasks. Not semantic AI decomposition; not additions to canonical 32 squads.
simpleBriefRevision.effort: Uncalibrated human-effort coefficients, 9–27 hours for the fixed software template regardless of request scale. Not measured completion time, AI speed, schedule or price. Unknown work remains unestimated; parent acceptance only adds its review effort.
simpleBriefRevision.storage: Same Goal schema/key; optional validated requestBrief stores request, Goal and intent. Review draft stays in memory; confirmed old/new Goals round-trip. Existing Goal retained until confirmed replacement with raw concurrency check.
safetyChecks: No save before explicit confirmation; goal and intent are both required.
Only approve_plan is recorded after confirmation; all tasks remain pending.
Free rewording of Goal is supported; software keyword gating applies to original request only.
IME composition cannot submit unfinished request text; rendered text is escaped.
Existing catalog, chat and ledger remain under advanced disclosure.
Leaf counts exclude parent tasks; all-task completion requests overall acceptance rather than another handoff.
Unknown remaining effort is not presented as a zero estimate.
No AI requests, automatic progress collection, notification delivery, cloud start, paid action, hardware action or deployment.

boardRevision.request: Match the supplied five-division squad/task progress screenshot in the standalone AMC workbench.
boardRevision.display: Canonical 32-squad board is the default view, reusing the existing mission renderer with the current 376 records. Squad selection shows Goal/outcome/scoped stage/gaps/next tasks; task links navigate primary owners, children, parents, prerequisites and downstream work. Rules, holds, steps, deliverables, criteria and evidence remain inspectable.
boardRevision.separation: Canonical embedded snapshot remains read-only and distinct from request-scoped proposed roles and Goal sessions. No task/Goal state, assignment, stage, completion or authority is changed by browsing.
boardRevision.storage: Presentation selection alone uses amc-mission-selection-v1. Existing Goal/chat schemas and keys remain. Invalid/unavailable selection storage falls back safely without overwriting records on load. Tab switching preserves drafts; starting over asks before discarding an unfinished simple request/review.
